description: Cycling - strategic routes is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Open Data Bristol. Key named cycling routes radiating out from the centre of Bristol that are mostly marked en route by sign posts with the colour-coded route name shown in a consistent manner, allowing easier navigation. Many of these include significant amounts of dedicated cycling infrastructure (such as off-road cycle tracks). Coverage: Bristol. Its keywords are Datagov. The portal shows 12 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
